name: fuse_characters
semantics: Build fusion character record rec(fused) from rec(member_a)/rec(member_b): rec+2 = form_char(member_b) | form_char(member_a)<<4 | fusion_kind<<8 (fusion components); maxHP/HP/maxEP/EP/stats = (a+b)*0x9A>>8 (60% of the sum); rec(fused)+8 = seconds*60 frames (or -1 if seconds == -1 = permanent); rec(fused)+0 |= 3 (unlocked+active); rec(member_a/b)+0 &= ~1 (members unavailable while fused).
evidence: emulator: fuse_characters(5,0,2,3,300) wrote GD+0x700 (rec5): +0 02->03, +2 = 0x23, +8 = 18000, stats = 60% of sums; used by the fusion-dance script #13 and #476/#501

name: spawn_map_item_at

evidence: emulator (round 2, re/buu/script_v2_t*.py): in area (4,30) spawn_map_item_at(0,130,130): 128 RAM words vs none (02031564:01150000->01140000; 020319a8:000000f6->000000f5; 020319b4:001b0301->001e0301; 02031a14:000000ca->000000c9 (+124)) (v2_map_item_at.png); previously: asm: 0x080090E6 indexes area->map +0x1C, 0x0800DCDC builds a pickup from the supply (0x083BD2F8) or equipment (0x086F82EC) table; #398 spawn_map_item_at(0,160,178) after an event

name: spawn_map_item
semantics: Same as spawn_map_item_at but the position/extra args are the globals 0x03001010/0x03001018 (normally 0 = the pickup's own placement).
evidence: emulator (round 2, re/buu/script_v2_t*.py): spawn_map_item(0): 115 RAM words vs none (v2_map_item.png); previously: asm only; no uses in table scripts

name: show_radar
semantics: Anti-tamper check: sum bytes 0x08000000..0x0800009F (mod 256) != 0x33 -> [0x03001004] = 1 (read by native 0xF6). Then create the radar HUD entity (vtable 0x0804B400, OBJ tiles from 0x08753008; top-left semicircle) and add it to the world. The radar accepts targets through world message 0x1B (native 0xAC) and resets on message 0x0B.
evidence: emulator: semicircle radar appears top-left; with the genuine ROM 0xF6 still returns 0

name: radar_add_target
semantics: Broadcast world message 0x1B with (x, y); the radar entity appends the point to its target list (+0x1C count, 8-byte entries) and shows a blip.
evidence: emulator (round 2, re/buu/script_v2_t*.py): show_radar(); radar_add_target(300,300) vs show_radar() alone: 0203de8c:02020202->02020000; 0203de90:02020202->02000002; 0203de98:00000000->00000001; 0203de9c:00000001->0000012c; 0203dea0:00000000->0000012c; 03006b18:030001f4->0300014c; previously: asm of radar handler 0x0802BC21; blip seen in emulator

name: respawn_breakables

evidence: emulator (round 2, re/buu/script_v2_t*.py): area (1,16): breakable with condition "flag 0x0B clear"; entered with the flag set, then clear_flag(0x0B): with respawn_conditional_map_objects 70 RAM words differ from without (0202f310:00ee0000->00ed0000; 0202f960:00670001->00660001; 0202fb00:0203dee4->0203deac; 0203de64:001cf7b7->000ef7a9 (+66)); previously: asm; #413/#418 call it right after set_flag natives

name: run_scene
